whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Hariram's Sweets & Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has amazing 4.1★ reviews across 1,000+ happy customers in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and online menu page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme online mithai menu, direct WhatsApp order booking, aur location map integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/harirams

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Hariram's Sweets & Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Hariram's Sweets & Restaurant in Kankarbagh) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? It features a digital mithai and food menu, direct WhatsApp order booking, and festival special showcase. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual dishes aur prices add karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
